summary: Iteration 73 - Verified iOS Install Prompt fixes for Apple users. ALL TESTS PASSED. iOS detection correctly identifies iPhone/iPad/iPod via user agent and iPadOS desktop mode via maxTouchPoints. Safari vs non-Safari browser detection works correctly (excludes Chrome iOS, Firefox iOS, Edge iOS, Opera). Support Center displays Apple-specific install steps with 4 clear steps. All data-testid attributes present and functional.

test_results.test_1_ios_safari_detection: PASS - iPhone Safari correctly detected (isIos=true, isSafari=true)
test_results.test_2_ios_chrome_detection: PASS - iPhone Chrome correctly detected as non-Safari (isIos=true, isSafari=false)
test_results.test_3_ios_firefox_detection: PASS - iPhone Firefox correctly detected as non-Safari (isIos=true, isSafari=false)
test_results.test_4_ipad_desktop_mode_detection: PASS - iPadOS desktop mode detected via maxTouchPoints > 1
test_results.test_5_support_center_ios_steps: PASS - 4 iOS install steps visible: Safari, Share, Add to Home Screen, Add
test_results.test_6_support_center_apple_mentions: PASS - Apple users, Safari, iPhone, iPad all mentioned in install card
test_results.test_7_support_center_data_testids: PASS - All 11 data-testid attributes found and visible
test_results.test_8_landing_page_install_link: PASS - 'Install App' link visible on landing page
test_results.test_9_landing_page_support_link: PASS - 'Support & install info' link navigates to Support Center
test_results.test_10_install_prompt_data_testids: PASS - All expected data-testid attributes defined in component

features_verified.ios_detection: iPhone/iPad/iPod detected via /iphone|ipad|ipod/ regex + iPadOS desktop mode via platform='MacIntel' && maxTouchPoints > 1
features_verified.ios_safari_path: Shows 'On iPhone/iPad Safari: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.' + numbered steps
features_verified.ios_non_safari_path: Shows 'On iPhone/iPad, open this app in Safari first...' + Copy app link button
features_verified.reopen_chip: Dismissed prompt shows reopen chip with 'Install App' button (data-testid='install-reopen-chip')
features_verified.support_center_ios_steps: 4 steps: Open in Safari, Tap Share icon, Select Add to Home Screen, Tap Add
